chapterInfo.content:
13
Hiob bɔ ne nnamfo Nyankopɔn tenenee ho kɔkɔ
1Hwɛ, m’ani ahunu ne nyinaa, m’aso nso ate, na ate aseɛ;
2 # Hiob 12.3 deɛ monim no, me nso menim.
Mentɔ mu wɔ mo mu.
3Me deɛ, mepɛ sɛ anka me ne Otumfoɔ no mmom bɛkasa,
na mehwehwɛ sɛ me ne Onyankopɔn bɛyiyi nsɛm ano.
4Na mo deɛ, moyɛ atorofoɔ mapa,
ayaresafoɔ ahuhufoɔ ne mo nyinaa.
5 # Mmb 17.28 Sɛ momua mo ano mmom koraa a,
anka ɛyɛ mo nyansa.
6Montie me nkurobɔ,
na monyɛ aso mma m’anoyie.
7Mobɛka deɛ ɛntene ama Onyankopɔn,
na mode nnaadaa aka ama no anaa?
8Mobɛgye ne ti,
anaasɛ mobɛham ama Onyankopɔn?
9Ɔhwehwɛ mo mu a, ɛbɛsi yie,
anaasɛ mobɛdaadaa no sɛdeɛ wɔdaadaa ɔdasani?
10Sɛ mohwɛ nnipa anim kokoa mu a,
ɔbɛka mo anim ampa.
11Ne kɛseyɛ rentu mo akoma,
na ne ho hu mma mo so?
12Mo kasammebuo yɛ nso mmebusɛm,
mo anoyie yɛ dɔteɛ anoyie.
13Mommua mo ano mfiri me so, na me ara menkasa,
na deɛ ɛbɛba me soɔ mmra.
14Adɛn nti na memfa me honam mentua me se ano,
na memfa me kra mento me nsam?
15Sɛ ɔreku me mpo a, mehwɛ ɔno ara;
mede me nsɛm bɛto n’anim.
16Yei ara nso na ɛbɛyɛ me nkwagyeɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ remma n’anim.
17Montie, montie deɛ mewɔ meka,
na m’asɛm nkyerɛaseɛ nhyɛne mo aso mu.
18Hwɛ, masiesie m’asɛm mato hɔ,
menim sɛ me na mɛdi bem.
19Hwan ne deɛ ɔne me bɛham?
Ɛnneɛ anka mɛyɛ komm na magyaa mu.
20Ao! AWURADE, sɛ woreyɛ adeɛ mmienu yi pɛ ama me a,
ɛno na meremfa me ho menhunta mfiri w’anim:
21 # Hiob 9.34 Yi wo nsa firi me so kɔ akyirikyiri,
na mma wo ho hu nnkuta me;
22ɛno na frɛ me, na me nso mɛgye so,
anaasɛ mɛkasa, na woabua me.
23Me bɔne ne me mfomsoɔ yɛ ahe ara?
Ma menhunu me mmarato ne me bɔne.
24 # Hiob 19.11 Adɛn nti na wode w’ani hunta,
na wobu me wo tamfo?
25Wobɛyi ahahan a mframa de rekorɔ ahi,
na wobɛti nkraadua a adwan?
26 # Dwom 25.7 Na wotwerɛɛ me ho nsɛm yaya,
na woma medi me mmeranteberɛ mu bɔne so adeɛ.
27Wode me nan hyehyɛ ɛpa mu,
na wowɛn m’akwan nyinaa,
wotwa m’anammɔn ho hyeɛ.
28Na onipa deɛ, ɔporɔ sɛ dufɔkyeɛ,
sɛ ntoma a nweweboaa redie.

Hwɛ, m’ani ahunu ne nyinaa, m’aso nso ate, na ate aseɛ;
deɛ monim no, me nso menim.
Mentɔ mu wɔ mo mu.
Me deɛ, mepɛ sɛ anka me ne Otumfoɔ no mmom bɛkasa,
na mehwehwɛ sɛ me ne Onyankopɔn bɛyiyi nsɛm ano.
Na mo deɛ, moyɛ atorofoɔ mapa,
ayaresafoɔ ahuhufoɔ ne mo nyinaa.
Sɛ momua mo ano mmom koraa a,
anka ɛyɛ mo nyansa.
Montie me nkurobɔ,
na monyɛ aso mma m’anoyie.
Mobɛka deɛ ɛntene ama Onyankopɔn,
na mode nnaadaa aka ama no anaa?
Mobɛgye ne ti,
anaasɛ mobɛham ama Onyankopɔn?
Ɔhwehwɛ mo mu a, ɛbɛsi yie,
anaasɛ mobɛdaadaa no sɛdeɛ wɔdaadaa ɔdasani?
Sɛ mohwɛ nnipa anim kokoa mu a,
ɔbɛka mo anim ampa.
Ne kɛseyɛ rentu mo akoma,
na ne ho hu mma mo so?
Mo kasammebuo yɛ nso mmebusɛm,
mo anoyie yɛ dɔteɛ anoyie.
Mommua mo ano mfiri me so, na me ara menkasa,
na deɛ ɛbɛba me soɔ mmra.
Adɛn nti na memfa me honam mentua me se ano,
na memfa me kra mento me nsam?
Sɛ ɔreku me mpo a, mehwɛ ɔno ara;
mede me nsɛm bɛto n’anim.
Yei ara nso na ɛbɛyɛ me nkwagyeɛ,
ɛfiri sɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ remma n’anim.
Montie, montie deɛ mewɔ meka,
na m’asɛm nkyerɛaseɛ nhyɛne mo aso mu.
Hwɛ, masiesie m’asɛm mato hɔ,
menim sɛ me na mɛdi bem.
Hwan ne deɛ ɔne me bɛham?
Ɛnneɛ anka mɛyɛ komm na magyaa mu.
Ao! AWURADE, sɛ woreyɛ adeɛ mmienu yi pɛ ama me a,
ɛno na meremfa me ho menhunta mfiri w’anim:
Yi wo nsa firi me so kɔ akyirikyiri,
na mma wo ho hu nnkuta me;
ɛno na frɛ me, na me nso mɛgye so,
anaasɛ mɛkasa, na woabua me.
Me bɔne ne me mfomsoɔ yɛ ahe ara?
Ma menhunu me mmarato ne me bɔne.
Adɛn nti na wode w’ani hunta,
na wobu me wo tamfo?
Wobɛyi ahahan a mframa de rekorɔ ahi,
na wobɛti nkraadua a adwan?
Na wotwerɛɛ me ho nsɛm yaya,
na woma medi me mmeranteberɛ mu bɔne so adeɛ.
Wode me nan hyehyɛ ɛpa mu,
na wowɛn m’akwan nyinaa,
wotwa m’anammɔn ho hyeɛ.
Na onipa deɛ, ɔporɔ sɛ dufɔkyeɛ,
sɛ ntoma a nweweboaa redie.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
